discovered_blocker.description: Request V3 and the orchestration plan carry recent_performance.parameters.lookback_trading_days, but unified_market_evidence_execution_request.v1 does not preserve operation parameters. A production H3 executor therefore cannot prove which 1..20D lookback was authorized.
why_blocking: H3 frozen semantics require exact requested lookback_trading_days
the executor must not guess 5D, 20D or any other lookback
the lookback must participate in the authorization-bound execution request identity/hash
runtime activation before this binding exists would be semantically unauditable

decision.summary: Introduce a new internal unified_market_evidence_execution_request.v2 for recent_performance operations. Preserve execution-request v1 bytes and behavior for existing routes. V2 adds an authorization-bound parameters object containing lookback_trading_days and includes those parameters in the execution request identity hash.
decision.phase_h_route_activation_after_a0: still inactive pending H-ACT-H3 implementation and acceptance

execution_request_v2_contract.capability_binding_rule: v2 is emitted only for capability_id=recent_performance in this tranche
execution_request_v2_contract.identity_hash_rule: execution_request_hash MUST be computed over the same identity body as v1 plus the exact parameters object; lookback_trading_days therefore changes both hash and umereq-v2 id
execution_request_v2_contract.relative_contained_output_path_rule: retain the existing operation-id-bound contained path format; filename does not encode execution-request version

projection_rules.h3_missing_parameter: FAIL_CLOSED execution_request_schema_invalid or a narrower deterministic projection error
projection_rules.non_h3_operations: continue to emit execution_request.v1 exactly as before

preflight_and_dispatch_compatibility.orchestrator_preflight_v1: may be additively broadened to accept a closed oneOf of execution_request.v1 and execution_request.v2 items; this post-freeze compatibility amendment MUST NOT change preflight identity/authorization/containment semantics
preflight_and_dispatch_compatibility.dispatch: must validate each bounded execution request against the schema declared by request.schema_version; v1 and v2 are both accepted, unknown versions fail closed
preflight_and_dispatch_compatibility.evidence_aggregation: must remain version-agnostic and bind request id/hash exactly as emitted
preflight_and_dispatch_compatibility.receipt_and_consumption_lineage: must preserve exact execution_request_id/hash without lossy normalization

h3_runtime_preconditions_after_a0: selected-route deterministic integration fixture for H3
H0H-LIVE-003 bound to accepted TWSE bounded-live evidence or a route-level activation live proof
Catalog V3 / Routing V3 / executor registry / portable projection synchronization
prohibited_in_a0: changing H3 source adapter or walker behavior
changing Result V3 or Audit V3 schema

findings_closed: current Request V3 already carries recent_performance.parameters.lookback_trading_days while execution-request v1 drops operation parameters
activation without parameter binding would force the executor to guess the authorized lookback and is therefore blocked
the selected remedy is additive execution-request v2 rather than mutation of execution-request v1
v2 binds exact lookback_trading_days into execution_request_hash and umereq-v2 identity
non-H3 routes retain execution-request v1 behavior
public Request/Result/Audit V3 contracts remain unchanged
A0 itself performs no executor registration, route activation, MCP expansion, polling, scheduling or history persistence
H-ACT-H3 remains blocked until A0 implementation/acceptance passes
